تَلْتَلَةٌ inf. n. of R. Q. 1 [q. v.]. ―
-b2- Also Hardship, difficulty, distress, or adversity: (M, K:) pl. تَلَاتِلُ, (TA,) signifying hardships, difficulties, &c. (Aboo-Turáb, T, S, M.) ＝
-A2- A drinking-vessel that is made of the envelope (قِيقَآءَة, S, or قِيقَآء, M and K) of the spadix of a palm-tree; (S, M, K;) so called because what it contains is poured into the throat; (T;) as also ↓ تَلَّةٌ : (M, K:) it is said that نَبِيذ is drunk with it. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
